analysis.reason: 4일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 과매도 구간에서 탈출 중이며 MACD 히스토그램도 개선되는 흐름을 보이고 있다. 5일 저가가 20일 저가를 하회하지 않아 회복 신호가 관찰되나, 현재가($33.88)가 SMA5($34.28) 및 스윙 저항선($34.18) 아래에 있어 추가 상승 여부는 불확실하다. ADX 40.5로 추세는 뚜렷하나, -DI가 +DI보다 높아 하락 압력이 우세하다. 따라서 섣부른 진입보다는 추세 전환 확인이 필요하다.
analysis.reasonEn: 4-day streak of 'watchful' stance. RSI is exiting oversold territory and MACD histogram shows improvement. The 5-day low is holding above the 20-day low, signaling potential recovery. However, the current price ($33.88) remains below the SMA5 ($34.28) and swing resistance ($34.18), making further upside uncertain. ADX at 40.5 indicates a clear trend, but -DI is higher than +DI, suggesting downward pressure. Therefore, confirmation of trend reversal is needed before entry.

analysis.narrativeEn:

· Position vs SMA100/200 ($45.12/$46.93) — Below mid-to-long term moving averages, in a weak zone.
· 52-week position (13.6%) + Current price range near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (29.1→32.3) — Exiting oversold, weak upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1.0711→-0.0896) — Improving, but still weak signal for trend reversal.

[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($30.17) — Based on 5-day/20-day lows; potential for further decline if broken.
· Swing resistance ($34.18) — Based on 5-day high; short-term rebound expected on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (5-day low holding, not breaking 20-day low) — Observing recovery signals.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.03x) — Normal level, indicating moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) — RSI exiting oversold and MACD showing improvement, but maintaining a watchful stance due to SMA resistance and weekly non-trending conflict.
analysis.patternNote: 5일 저가가 20일 저가를 하회하지 않는 패턴은 회복 신호로 해석될 수 있으나, 현재가가 단기 저항선에 막혀 있어 추가 상승 여부는 불확실하다.
